contract: XR Learning Platform · V3 shared surfaces (XS)
status: Internal dependency artifact. Components are authored and tested in the XS design canvas; owner visual acceptance pending; not integrated in the React app. Role packages place these components and must not redesign them.

styles.shared_extension: xs-shared.css (every selector uses an xs- class; no global token changes)
styles.font: Public Sans (Google Fonts css2 link in each artboard helmet; no font binaries shipped)

design_host_usage.import: Copy the component .dc.html beside your artboards together with the four stylesheets, then <dc-import name="XsAccountMenu" embedded="{{ true }}" ...>. Attribute names are kebab-case (person-name -> personName). Callbacks are passed as {{ fn }}.
design_host_usage.embedded: Always pass embedded="{{ true }}" inside a workspace (.xr.rb). Without it the file renders as its own specimen artboard.
design_host_usage.ids: Pass a unique id-prefix per instance when a board shows more than one.

components.placement: Right end of .rb-top in every workspace page, wrapped in <div class="xs-acct-slot"> so it keeps margin-left:auto.

props.roleLabel: Student | Faculty | Institute Admin | Vendor | Academic Reviewer | Content Manager | Super Admin
props.org: string; institution for Student, Faculty and Institute Admin; the vendor's organisation for Vendor; empty for Academic Reviewer, Content Manager and Super Admin
props.device: boolean; true only for a Student with AR, VR or MR access
props.onSignOut: callback -> end the tab's sign-in, then XS-03 signed out
props.catcher: boolean, default true; galleries pass false

accessible_names.outside_click_layer: Close account menu (tabindex -1, not in the tab order)

components.pattern: Disclosure (button + list of links and a button), not an ARIA menu.
keyboard: Enter/Space or click opens and moves focus to the first item
ArrowDown on the closed button opens it
Escape closes and returns focus to the button
Outside click closes and returns focus to the button
Tab out of the last item closes without moving focus back
Choosing an item closes the menu; the destination moves focus to its H1
components.variant_ownership: XS owns every variant; role workstreams only supply the person's data.

components.placement: The page content of the Help & support destination at the foot of every rail; also reached from the account menu, banners and message pages.
list_states: empty (primary action moves into the empty state)

props.reports: array of {id, title, status: open|reopened|resolved, sent, iso, what, where, shot, resolved?, note?, reopened?, history[{what, when, note?}]}; owned by the host
props.showRefs: boolean, default true; false for Super Admin (no SUP numbers anywhere, including accessible names)
props.where: string pre-filled from the page the person came from
props.dateLong: string for the phone eyebrow date
props.today: string date stamped on a new report
props.onSubmit: callback(draft {title, what, where, shot}) -> returns the stored record {id, ...}
props.resetToken: number; change it to bring the component back to the list

validation_copy.field: Say what happened, so it can be looked into

rules: No response times, service levels or promises about who answers (ND-14).
Resolving and reopening are Super Admin actions (SA-20, SA-21); the reporter reads the resolution note.
Nothing is sent by e-mail; status is read here only (T-34).
Title in lists = first sentence of What happened (prototype rule; keep the app's existing title rule if it differs).
components.variant_ownership: XS owns all views and states. The Super Admin variant is showRefs=false.

components.placement: The page content inside the normal workspace shell; no rail item is current.

props.workspace: role label of the signed-in person (never the protected page's workspace)

notallowed: This page isn’t part of your workspace
You’re signed in to the {workspace} workspace. This address belongs to a different workspace.
inactive: Nothing can be opened while the account is inactive. Contact your institution administrator.

accessible_names.heading: the page's only H1, focused on arrival

rules: Never show the protected page's title, records, route, role code or error code.
Paused always adds that work is kept.
Room for one admin-written reason line if the pause-reason decision allows it (open).
components.variant_ownership: XS owns the template. PU-15 Not found may reuse it; that copy belongs to Public.

components.placement: banner: first child of <main class="rb-page"> on every page of an affected person (as in the V3 IA-02 seed). page: the role workstream's home page, under the H1.

who_sees_it.paused: Institute Admin, Faculty and Students of a paused institution
who_sees_it.inactive: Students and Faculty whose account is inactive

copy.banner_paused: Your institution’s access is paused — your work is kept. · Help
copy.banner_inactive: Your account is inactive. Contact your institution administrator. · Help
page_paused_student: You can’t open experiments right now
Your institution’s access is paused. Your work is kept, and you can continue when it’s lifted.
page_paused_ia: BITS has paused your institution’s access
Students can’t open experiments. Pages are read-only until BITS lifts the pause.
page_inactive: Nothing can be opened right now
Your account is inactive. Contact your institution administrator.

rules: Display only: it never grants, hides or restores access.
Signing out and in again does not remove it.
components.variant_ownership: XS owns the copy and look; role workstreams own where the page notice sits and which of their own actions are hidden.

components.placement: Whole page, outside the workspace shell. /sign-in and /signed-out are v46 route proposals; keep the app's routes.

props.returnLabel: string shown in the session-ended notice
props.onSignIn: callback(email) -> true when the host accepts the account (the host then navigates), false to show the wrong-details message
props.autofocus: boolean; move focus to the notice or H1 after an in-app arrival (sign out, return from public)
props.prototypeNote: boolean, default true; local prototype builds only

states: signing in (busy, cannot be sent twice)
institution sign-in starting (only with an identity provider; T-10)

validation_copy.email_format: Enter an e-mail address like name@institution.edu
wrong: The e-mail or password isn’t right

xs04_copy.forgot: Contact your institution administrator to reset it.
xs04_copy.first_time: Contact your institution administrator to find out how to sign in for the first time.

never: reset links, tokens or invitation e-mail
a success message for an e-mail that was never sent

shell_patches_proposed.what: Skip to main content link (xs-skip) as the first focusable element of the workspace shell; focuses <main tabindex=-1>.
shell_patches_proposed.why: WCAG 2.4.1: up to 8 rail links precede the content; the V3 seeds have no bypass.
shell_patches_proposed.aesthetics: Hidden until focused; no visual change otherwise.

shell_patches_proposed.what: After choosing a rail or drawer destination, close the drawer and move focus to the new page's H1 (tabindex -1).
shell_patches_proposed.why: V3 seeds leave focus on the old link or the Menu button.
In the V3 seeds the button is labelled Account menu but opens nothing.

nav_targets.note: Route strings are historical v46 proposals for identification. Claude Code keeps the application's actual routes.

internal_ids: Super Admin interfaces hide REQ/ACC/UPD/DTR/SUP/SUB numbers, including accessible labels (XsHelp showRefs=false). All other roles keep their documented references; academic course codes stay everywhere.
